title: ophryosporus galioides
intro: Ophryosporus galioides, commonly known as the "Gallium Plant", is a type of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Ophryosporus galioides include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
